definitions.explanation: A casual establishment where people go to drink alcohol, typically serving food as well. Covers a range of places from small standing bars to izakaya-style pubs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{屋|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to the bar near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲|の}み{屋|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: There are many bars lined up along this street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{屋|や}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{話|はな}していた→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Yesterday I was talking late at a bar with my coworkers.

notes:
USAGE:
A casual, everyday word for places where people drink alcohol. More colloquial than ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧, which specifically refers to Japanese-style pubs. {飲|の}み{屋|や} can refer to any type of drinking establishment, from a tiny {立|た}ち{飲|の}み (standing bar) to a larger pub.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{屋|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a bar)
- ⟦{行|い}きつけ→行きつけ：19123_ikitsuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{屋|や} (one's regular bar)
- {飲|の}み{屋|や}{街|がい} (bar district)
- ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧{飲|の}み{屋|や} (cheap bar)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧: Japanese-style pub — more specific, often used as a business name
- ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧: bar — suggests a Western-style establishment
- ⟦{酒場|さかば}→酒場：00356_sakaba⟧: drinking place — slightly literary or old-fashioned
